purpose: Capability registry for literature discovery, completeness auditing, TOC retrieval, and website synchronization. The primary literature task must select the newest stable compatible capability on main before each fetch run.
fingerprintMethod: sha256 of newline-joined stable component labels and blob SHAs: literatureAudit, literatureWorkflow, journalRegistry, completenessGuard, tocCollector, publisherFallback

literatureAudit.validation: Last known stable discovery implementation before the 2026-09-21 source-coverage guard patch. It completed the 2026-09-19..2026-09-21 primary run with a seven-day machine safety tail, 15 target journals, criticalSourceFailures=0 and sourceFamilyGaps=0.
literatureAudit.comparisonToPriorStable: The prior stable implementation used a seven-day window as the routine audit window. The new stable implementation makes three days the primary semantic-review window but retains seven days of machine-only source coverage across Crossref online/published/created and OpenAlex. Already resolved days 4-7 do not become routine GPT re-review work; only genuinely unseen DOI differences surface. verifiedThrough catch-up automatically widens the primary publication range after interrupted/source-failure closure.
literatureAudit.semanticImpact: Complexity reduction without a source-recall downgrade: routine GPT review is three days, while seven-day multi-source safety-tail discovery, Crossref created/deposit rescue, 15-journal coverage, source-family health checks, all-difference review, prospective activation cutoffs, and persistent review decisions remain mandatory.

literatureWorkflow.validation: The workflow now runs the completeness capability guard before building the DOI-union audit and persisted the post-guard audit report in commit 7a212252a399abff49ac95978120df0dbc18cb3d.
literatureWorkflow.semanticImpact: Prevents silent regression of the 15-journal registry, prospective activation dates, seven-day rescan, Crossref created-date rescue, source-family health reporting, and all-difference review flow.

journalRegistry.validation: 15 canonical target journals are centralized. Chem, Chemical Science, CCS Chemistry, Science Advances, and Green Chemistry have activeFrom=2026-09-19; existing ten journals retain activeFrom=2026-07-01.
journalRegistry.semanticImpact: Prevents duplicated journal lists and prevents the new five journals from being backfilled before 2026-09-19 even when the safety window or late-deposit rescue reaches earlier dates.

completenessGuard.validation: Last known passing completeness guard before the 2026-09-21 source-coverage regression extension. It enforces 15 journals, three-day primary review, seven-day multi-source safety tail, verifiedThrough catch-up, Crossref online/published/created union, OpenAlex coverage, late-deposit observability, source-family health, and no silent keyword exclusion.
completenessGuard.semanticImpact: CI now rejects either direction of regression: expanding routine GPT work back to seven days or shrinking the machine safety coverage below seven days.

websiteMediaSync.validation: GitHub Pages run 35418810801 succeeded with galleryDois=463, workerItems=463, finalRecords=407, failures=0 and figure metadata=716
websiteMediaSync.semanticImpact: Downstream media synchronization coverage only. Adds rolling-supplement.json to media sync; does not alter literature discovery, inclusion decisions, or upstream TOC retrieval.

recentMediaRepair.validation: GitHub Actions run 35419525431 completed successfully on the Sep 18-19 reviewed literature update; it prepared 30 recent gaps, attempted direct publisher retrieval, ran the Worker fallback, verified inventory, and triggered Pages refresh.
recentMediaRepair.effectiveness: Publisher direct retrieval remained blocked by ACS/Wiley 403 and Nature IDP for most targets; the workflow is operationally stable but currently low-yield without an authenticated browser/VPN source.
recentMediaRepair.semanticImpact: TOC/media repair only. Does not change literature discovery or inclusion decisions.

changes: Record per-journal Crossref/OpenAlex candidate coverage for the full safety window and closure date.
Flag severe source-family coverage collapse even when HTTP requests technically succeed.
Block verifiedThroughEligible when the closure date has a severe Crossref/OpenAlex coverage anomaly.
Expose sourceCoverageAnomalies and closureCoverageAnomalies in audit/latest.json.
pendingValidation.promotionRule: Promote only after the literature-audit workflow passes the completeness guard and produces a fresh audit/latest.json containing the new coverage fields with no unexpected closureCoverageAnomalies.
